title: Imam Bayildi
subtitle: Turkish baked stuffed aubergines with tomatoes and onion
excerpt: Imam bayildi is a Turkish vegetarian dish of aubergines stuffed with a slow-cooked onion and tomato filling, then baked until completely tender. It is served at room temperature and improves with time, making it ideal for cooking ahead.
sourceNotes: Based on classic Turkish imam bayildi. The dish is found across the eastern Mediterranean and Middle East in various forms.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Best made several hours ahead and served at room temperature. Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

content.text: Salt the cut aubergines for 20 minutes before cooking to draw out bitterness and soften them slightly. This helps them absorb the olive oil more evenly.

items.prepNote: 4 for the filling, 2 for the aubergines

content.text: Score the cut side of each aubergine half in a cross-hatch pattern. Salt the surfaces and leave for 20 minutes. Pat dry with kitchen paper.
Heat the oven to 190C. Brush the aubergines with 2 tbsp olive oil. Place cut-side down on the baking tray. Roast for 20 minutes.
While they roast, heat 4 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion. Cook for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin, and cinnamon. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tinned tomatoes, tomato puree, and bay leaves. Simmer for 10 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Season.
Flip the roasted aubergines cut-side up. Use a spoon to gently press down the flesh to make a hollow.
Spoon the tomato filling generously into each hollow. Return to the oven for 20 to 25 minutes until the aubergine is completely tender.
Leave to cool to room temperature. Scatter with parsley and serve.

items.symptom: Aubergine is still firm after baking
items.cause: Not roasted long enough in the first stage
items.fix: Give it 5 more minutes before adding the filling.

items.symptom: Filling runs off instead of staying in
items.cause: No hollow pressed into the flesh
items.fix: Press firmly with the back of a spoon before filling.

items.cause: Aubergine was not salted before roasting
items.fix: Always salt and rest for 20 minutes, then pat dry.
